name: support_triage
title: Support ticket triage
description: A tiny custom suite: classify support tickets and answer with a strict label. Copy it as a starting point for your own evals.
system: You are a support triage assistant. Answer with exactly one lowercase label and nothing else.

items.prompt:
Ticket: "I was charged twice for my subscription this month."
Labels: billing, bug, feature-request, account.
Reply with the label only.

Ticket: "The app crashes every time I press Export to PDF."
Labels: billing, bug, feature-request, account.
Reply with the label only.

Ticket: "Could you add a dark mode to the dashboard?"
Labels: billing, bug, feature-request, account.
Reply with the label only.

Ticket: "I cannot log in and the reset email never arrives."
Labels: billing, bug, feature-request, account.
Reply with the label only.
Write a one-sentence apology to a customer whose order arrived late. Use between 8 and 20 words and include the word 'sorry'.
items.reference: We are truly sorry that your order arrived later than we promised.
